Focused
on excellence.

Many attorneys’ offices do a little bit of everything. Here at Henkels & Baker, PC, we choose to do two things exceptionally well:

  • We lift the burden of debt to give people a fresh financial start
  • We defend people facing criminal charges to protect their freedom, reputation and driving privileges.

Could we make more money if we added other practice areas? Probably. But then we couldn’t focus on being the best.

Choosing someone to defend your rights is an important decision and we take that responsibility seriously. Just like you, many of our team members have also faced criminal charges or overwhelming debt. We’ve felt frustrated by attorneys who didn’t seem to have enough time to return phone calls or review the details of our case. So we built the law firm we wish we had.

Our History

& Firm

Decades of Experience, One Team Committed to You

Francis William Henkels began practicing bankruptcy law in 1973. Dustin Baker started his career as a criminal defense attorney in 2011. In 2018, they joined their practices to form Henkels & Baker, bringing decades of bankruptcy experience and a dedicated criminal defense practice under one roof.

Since Fran’s retirement in 2024, Dustin continues to manage our firm and lead the bankruptcy practice. In 2025, Jason Van Hemert joined as a criminal associate attorney, bringing years of experience from both sides of the aisle.

A law firm is much more than just attorneys, however, and we pride ourselves on having an exceptional legal support team. From the front desk to the back office, every team member here cares about you and your case.

Call us today to learn more or schedule a free consultation to experience exceptional legal service for yourself.

Our Attorneys.

Dustin Baker

Managing Attorney

Dustin Baker

Managing Attorney

Dustin Baker was born and raised in Dubuque, Iowa, and graduated from Loras College in 2001 and the University of Iowa College of Law in 2003. After working on trusts and estates, regulatory compliance and corporate legal matters for a national bank holding company, he consulted with international clients in Chicago and Washington, D.C., before returning to Iowa to open his own criminal defense practice. While his focus is mainly on bankruptcy, complex debt negotiation and student loan adversary cases, he continues to manage the criminal defense department and consults on criminal cases daily.

Jason Van Hemert

Associate Attorney

Jason Van Hemert was born and raised in Des Moines, Iowa, and graduated from Cornell University (NY, 2001) and the University of Illinois College of Law (Champaign-Urbana, 2004). Beginning his career as an Illinois assistant state’s attorney, he then practiced criminal defense as part of a larger general practice before becoming an advocate for homeowners distressed by the mortgage foreclosure crisis of 2008. Jason helped to save his clients’ homes through a combined strategy of bankruptcy, mortgage refinance, foreclosure defense, and other real estate strategies. Since returning to Iowa, Jason continues to assist his clients with bankruptcy and financial matters but has resumed his focus on criminal law, where he has tried dozens of successful trials before the bench and juries, and is committed to ensuring fair and just results for his clients on both sides of the river.

Fran Henkels

Founder, Retired

Fran Henkels has over 50 years of experience practicing business and finance law. As an attorney specializing in bankruptcy and business/agribusiness restructures, he helped many community members during the farm and mortgage crisis of the 1980s. Local officials have also relied on his expertise as a member of the County Compensation Board, as well as the City of Dubuque Arts and Cultural Affairs Advisory Commission and Civic Center Advisory Commission. Fran is also certified as a mediator by the International Academy of Dispute Resolution.   Education
